svg.text: TECHNICAL RUNBOOK INDEX · 12 EXERCISES · AIRPORT PAYMENTS FRAUD PIPELINE
Exercise Runbooks: Platform Setup to Governed Operations
Each frame maps one lab's execution sequence (1→2→3→4), focal mechanism, compose profile, verify check, and artifact.
VERIFY: observable check · OUT: artifact / UI port
